sources.snippet: OpenCAL — Open-Source Computed Axial Lithography Software OpenCAL is open-source software for building and operating a Computed Axial Lithography (CAL) 3D printer — a volumetric, layer-less resin printing technique. It is designed to run headless on a Raspberry Pi 5 and is controlled through a hardware LCD/encoder interface.
